title: Embedding a trajectory property
statement: Let $C$ be a contract for a machine with $m$ work tapes, and embed those tapes into a machine with $k$ work tapes by an injection of tape indices. If a predicate $R$ holds throughout every eligible trajectory of $C$, then throughout every eligible trajectory of the induced embedded contract, $R$ holds for the selected configuration and the selected head positions; moreover, each unselected head position equals its value in the starting configuration.
hypotheses_covered: σ is an injection from the m tape indices into the k tape indices
replaced:
Let $m,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $\sigma$ embed the $m$ work tapes into the $k$
work tapes, and let $C$ be a contract for a machine with $m$ work tapes. Suppose that
along every run covered by $C$, a property $R$ holds of the original configuration and
all work-head positions up to the contract time. Then, along every run of the embedded
contract, $R$ holds for the selected configuration and the corresponding selected head
positions; moreover, every unselected work-head position remains equal to its initial
value.
